objectives.title: Operate an autonomous evidence-driven portfolio intelligence system
objectives.statement: Build a self-triggering portfolio intelligence layer that continuously observes, learns, hunts, experiments, verifies, and improves without requiring interactive ChatGPT for ordinary operation while keeping consequential external authority human-gated.
success_conditions: Ordinary portfolio learning cycles can execute from durable automation without an interactive ChatGPT prompt.
Verified outcomes update durable shared state and future decision policy.
constraints: No autonomous live trading or brokerage execution.
No secrets or private operational/customer payloads stored while this repository is public.
evidence_requirements: Exact source revisions and durable event/evidence receipts.
Deterministic tests plus independent verification for consequential promotion.

objectives.title: Produce verified cash through bounded micro-products before new startup expansion
objectives.statement: Prioritize many cheap, bounded digital products with low support burden and measurable marketplace demand, starting with Roblox Creator Store models built from reusable capabilities already present in the portfolio. Freeze large speculative startups until verified external payment proves where further investment belongs.
success_conditions: At least one micro-product records independently verified external payment.
Every SKU has a bounded build-time cap, paid-AI spend cap, explicit price hypothesis, testable buyer use case, and kill rule before engineering begins.
Further engineering allocation follows actual sales, reviews, or buyer support evidence rather than internal feature count or opportunity scoring.
constraints: Do not fabricate demand, revenue, customer interest, sales, reviews, or payment.
Do not make purchases, publish paid listings, send unapproved external communications, or create customer commitments outside existing human authority gates.
Do not reuse copyrighted game assets, proprietary UI, trademarks, private code, or employer/customer data in commercial products without separate rights.
Prefer generic reusable mechanics built from existing portfolio capabilities and keep customer secrets and private payloads out of the public repository.
evidence_requirements: Provider-backed payment or settlement evidence tied to the specific engagement.
Delivery and customer-acceptance evidence tied to the agreed scope.
Current market-demand evidence or an inbound buyer request for the service category.
